scoring_justification: All target quantities are deterministic functions of given public physical constants and formulas; the checker recomputes them exactly from the agent's raw artifacts, achieving T1 recompute.

schema.description: Characteristic dimensionless parameters a and beta, length scale b in nm, time scale tau in microseconds.

outputs.description: Characteristic model parameters for water computed from analytical definitions using given physical properties.

schema.description: Relative humidity f0 and corresponding psychrometric relative temperature difference z_inf.
